data.name: Furaih
data.gender_notes: Furaih is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Furaih is an Arabic name. It is unisex. The meaning of Furaih is 'A happy person'. The name Furaih carries the meaning “A happy person” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Furaih usually hope their child will grow to embody a happy person and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Furaih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A happy person.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furaih total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فريج
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الفرج والسرور والخروج من الضيق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فريج مشتق من الفعل فرج يفرج فريجا، ويعني الفرج والسرور والخروج من الضيق. ورد ذكر الفعل في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر: ﴿وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا عَيْنًا وَرِزْقًا لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ﴾. يرمز الاسم إلى الفرج والنجاة من كل كرب وضيق، وغالبًا ما يطلق على الذكور.

in_urdu.name: فریح
in_urdu.meaning: فرج اور خوشی کا مطلب، نام خوشیاں اور آسائش کی نشانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فریح عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'فرج' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور آسائش۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، اس نام کا استعمال عموماً خوش قسمتی اور خوشگواری کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر اسلامی تقویم میں بھی کیا گیا ہے، جہاں یہ فرج اور نجاتی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फुरैह
in_hindi.meaning: फुरैह नाम का अर्थ है खुशी और सुख की अनुभूति कराने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: फुरैह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुख और आनंद की अनुभूति कराने वाला। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर सौभाग्य और सुखद जीवन के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में भी बताया गया है, जहां यह राहत और मुक्ति की निशानी है।

in_pashto.name: فریج
in_pashto.meaning: د خوښۍ او فرج معنی، د نوم د خوشحالۍ نښه
in_pashto.long_meaning: فریج نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د خوښۍ او فرج ده. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم اکثرا د خوشحالۍ او بریالیتوب نښه په توګه کارول کیږي. دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې د راحت او نجات د نښې په توګه هم بیان شوی دی.

in_english.name: Furaih
in_english.meaning: A name that signifies joy, relief, and happiness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Furaih originates from the Arabic root 'faraja,' which means to relieve or to console. It signifies joy, relief, and happiness. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with comfort and deliverance from distress. It is often used to express good fortune and is linked to Quranic references that highlight relief and solace. The name Furaih symbolizes positive attributes such as happiness and peace, making it a meaningful choice for many Muslim parents.

In various traditions and contexts, it is considered a virtue to inspire and maintain a state of happiness. The naming of a child Furaih could instill in that person a sense of innate joy and optimism which reflects in their personality and their interactions with the world. Moreover, it is a reminder of the transcendent power of happiness in challenging life's struggles. This name would be cherished in cultures that place emphasis on happiness as a fundamental aspect of human wellbeing and human relations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Furaih carries deep significance. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon Him) once said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity." This Hadith emphasizes that acts of kindness, kindness towards others, and acts of happiness bring blessings to both the giver and the receiver. The name Furaih could be seen as a call to be a beacon of happiness in people's lives, to bring joy to others, and to strive to find contentment in the small moments of life. Furthermore, it is a reminder of the importance of inner happiness and living a life filled with gratitude and appreciation. Seeking spiritual growth would be an integral part of the person named Furaih's journey, using the name as a reminder to focus on personal happiness and spreading happiness to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Furaih signifies one who is sincere, steadfast, and unwavering in faith. It is a reminder to always remain devoted to Allah, with pure intentions and unyielding resolve.
